Both identified positions reference the old 'Name' property and must be updated to 'DisplayName'. The observation dictionary key also changes from 'name' to 'display_name' to match the new runtime observation key.
runtimes/python/main.py: The schema rename changes v1 Entity.name to display_name on the same wire field 2. Both Python read (line 33) and construction (line 117) sites must use the new generated attribute display_name. The observation key becomes display_name per spec. Regenerated bindings will provide display_name; v2 is unchanged.

Protobuf JS/TS codegen converts snake_case field names to camelCase accessors (displayName). The TypeScript runtime must use the new accessor 'displayName' for both reading (line 13) and constructing (line 83) v1 entities. The observation key changes from 'name' to 'display_name' as specified. v2 Entity is unaffected. No test sources are modified.
